Appreciate quick confirmation so our finance team can schedule the trial billing.

Kimberly — reviewed the attachments. LocalVendor Business Registration looks valid (registered in Companies House; number matches). Maria: can you confirm the bank account details on the authorization form will match the remittance on the first invoice? We need that to open the vendor record.

Marissa — from payments operations perspective, invoice-only setups are allowed for low-volume pilot suppliers if we apply the following safeguards:
- Limit: max single-invoice value = 10,000 USD equivalent for first 90 days
- Approval matrix: VP Finance sign-off required for any invoice > 5,000 USD equivalent during pilot
- Accounting tag: vendor record flagged as "TEMP_INVOICE_ONLY" and routed to a single AP approver queue (no auto-PO matching)
- Evidence: at least one government registration doc + remittance confirmation (bank statement or transactional proof)

If Marissa signs off, I can approve the temporary vendor lane.

Regards,

Kim / Priyom / Maria — I've validated the supplier registration against Companies House and confirmed the VAT number. Maria, thanks for the quick turnaround.

Finance approves a temporary invoice-only onboarding under the following conditions:
1) Authorization window: 90 days from approval date (expires 2025-12-17).
2) Invoice cap: £10,000 (single invoice) — any invoice above this requires VP Finance sign-off.
3) Account setup: Redwood will create vendor record with tag "TEMP_INVOICE_ONLY; REVIEW_20251217" and route invoices to the Finance Ops queue for manual matching.
4) Remittance validation: first invoice must include a bank confirmation or cleared payment reference from their bank (photo/statement redacted OK).
5) Contracting: Procurement requests a simple SOW addendum confirming pilot scope and the invoicing arrangement — we can issue a short addendum template (DocuSign) for signature.

If you agree to the above, I'll ask AP to create the vendor record and share the onboarding link. Also attaching the DocuSign addendum draft (please sign so we have an executed paper trail).

Best,
